home.title: Design system lab
home.intro: Stage 1 building blocks for the backoffice and customer portal. Every page works in English and Urdu, on phone and desktop, and by keyboard.
home.stageNote: Business screens start in Stage 2. Links to them open a planned-screen page instead of a dead end.

cards.tokens: Colour pairs with measured contrast, spacing, and English and Urdu type specimens.
cards.components: Buttons, status labels, references, money, dates, menus, dialogs, drawers and toasts.
cards.forms: A complete form: async search, dependent unit picker, currency, date, phone, CNIC and upload.
cards.workspace: The 360° workspace pattern: header, tabs with overflow, related drawer and activity.
cards.states: Loading skeletons, empty, error, forbidden, offline and not-found states.

tokens.colourIntro: Each pair is measured with the WCAG formula. Text needs 4.5:1; control boundaries and focus need 3:1.
tokens.typeIntro: Inter for Latin text and figures; Noto Naskh Arabic for Urdu. Latin references inside Urdu stay left-to-right.
tokens.specimenBody: Booking LH-A-1204 is confirmed. The next installment of Rs 1,250,000.00 is due on 5 Nov 2026.

components.disabledReason: Disabled because the record is locked for month-end close.
components.statuses: Status labels (icon + text, never colour alone)
components.referencesIntro: IDs, phone numbers, CNICs and IBANs are isolated so Urdu layout never reorders them.
components.dialogBody: The unit becomes available to other customers immediately. The customer's lead stays open.
components.drawerBody: Drawers hold short tasks. On a phone they become a full-height sheet.
components.toastErrorText: The visit couldn't be scheduled. Nothing was changed.
components.tooltipText: Tooltips repeat a visible label; they never hold the only explanation.

forms.title: Forms
forms.intro: A realistic form built from the Stage 1 controls. Try it with the keyboard only, switch language mid-way, or go back and forward: your entries stay.
forms.submitted: Form is valid. In a later stage this would create the record; here nothing was saved.
forms.practiceLink: Use the practice version with a guided tour

workspace.title: Workspace pattern
workspace.intro: How every 360° record page will be laid out. The record is fictional.
workspace.tabPlaceholder: The {{tab}} tab is built with the workspace screens in Stage 2. The tab already has its own address.

states.title: Loading, empty and error states
states.intro: Every screen uses these same patterns, so problems are explained the same way everywhere.
states.liveFetchIntro: Uses the simulated network setting from the account menu, so you can try slow, error and offline behaviour.

customer.title: Customer portal preview
customer.intro: The same components in the customer personality: larger type, calmer layout, and bottom navigation on phones.
customer.stageNote: Portal screens are built in Stage 4. The navigation already works and shows each planned screen.
